notes.title: Steam update - Feb 24 2025
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43060804/2ecde98ed664723edba0b7f9d3d8a069f272c383.png[/img]

[b]Our existential themed visual novel Truer than You is part of Steam Next Fest![/b]
Truer than You is about the search for meaning in a capitalist society - set in a microcosm where commodified relationships, tech bros, climate activists, bored housewives and undercover artists are all in the mixture - portrayed with comic book style graphics and a bubble gum pastel palette. 

For the Next Fest, we have updated the demo - the updates are listed below.

[b]Demo updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] We have added a new intro to the game.
[*] The rating given by clients is now shown in the assignment details in the in-game app, and the mean rating is shown on the app’s starting page.
[*] The whole assignment system is updated, and this demo is the first that uses this new system. We managed to keep the Chinese localization of the demo, while rewriting a lot of the functionality.
[*] The in-game menu has gotten some new icons, and we took out the menu background since it took too much focus.
[/list]

[i][b]If you play the demo, please let us know what you think![/b][/i]

Please add Truer than You to to your wishlist
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2161830/Truer_than_You/

Join our Discord server: https://discord.gg/Nk4JYuz6WT
